Classic Crispy Roast Potatoes

Served at: Christmas Day

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 1 hr

Roast potatoes are a beloved staple on Christmas Day dinner tables across many English-speaking countries. They are prized for their crispy golden exterior and fluffy interior, making them the perfect accompaniment to roast meats and festive gravies.

Ingredients

  • 3 lbs (1.4 kg) Yukon Gold or Russet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil or goose fat
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
  • 2 sprigs fresh rosemary (optional)
  • 2 cloves garlic, crushed (optional)

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C).
  2. Place the peeled and cut potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil.
  3. Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until the edges start to soften but the centers are still firm.
  4. Drain the potatoes well and return them to the hot pot. Shake the pot gently to roughen up the edges of the potatoes; this helps create a crispy crust.
  5. Pour the oil or goose fat into a large roasting pan and heat it in the oven for 5 minutes until very hot.
  6. Carefully add the potatoes to the hot oil in the roasting pan, turning them to coat evenly.
  7. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, rosemary, and garlic if using.
  8. Roast the potatoes in the oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, turning them every 15 minutes to ensure even crisping and browning.
  9. Remove from the oven when golden and crispy. Serve immediately alongside your Christmas roast and gravy.

Tips

  • For extra crispiness, parboil the potatoes a day ahead, drain, and refrigerate uncovered to dry out before roasting.
  • Goose fat gives the best traditional flavor and crispiness, but vegetable oil or duck fat are good alternatives.
  • Add herbs like thyme or sage for a different aromatic twist.
